cryptographic_commitment_protocol.integrity_vs_confidentiality_ruling: SHA-256 guarantees content immutability; it does NOT provide confidentiality. If truth manifests or case files are readable in the codebase by the candidate owner, holdouts are unsealed.
cryptographic_commitment_protocol.ledger_recording: Commitments must be recorded on append-only custody ledger prior to qualification dispatch.
cryptographic_commitment_protocol.nonce_disclosure_schedule: Nonces and truth manifests are revealed to adjudicators only after all model responses are written to immutable disk.

current_sealing_status.reason: Independent author and independent custodian roles are not present in current single-agent environment. Sealed cases cannot be truthfully attested.

exposure_incident_protocol.trigger: Premature disclosure of case evidence or truth manifests to candidate prompt developer
exposure_incident_protocol.remediation: Exposed cases must be retired to development benchmark set; novel holdouts must be re-authored.
